name: preview-card-1j
title: Preview Card 1j: Inverted footer
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The footer is a solid ink bar, which reads as a button. The preview stays neutral.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
